description: Vibe CRM — Kontakte, Firmen, Deals. Next.js + NestJS + SQLite + Better Auth + Agent-CLI.
name: vibe-crm

scripts.dev:api: NODE_ENV=development LOCAL_WEB_ACCOUNT=true DATABASE_PATH=./data/vibe-crm.sqlite PORT=3100 WEB_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000 BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3100 BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)} npm run start:dev --workspace apps/api
scripts.dev:web: NODE_ENV=development LOCAL_WEB_ACCOUNT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3100 NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm run dev --workspace apps/web -- --hostname localhost --port 3000
